brief: Choose a customer-support platform for 50 users and 16000 annual tickets. All six requirements are mandatory: all-in first-year outlay (subscription + setup + usage/overage + legacy overlap + connector) at most USD 30000; current signed contract; production SAML and signed webhooks; durable workload pass rate at least 96 percent; binding EU-only scope for production, logs, backups and support; migration within 45 business days. UNKNOWN is not clearance. Among eligible candidates choose one within USD 0 of the cheapest eligible all-in first-year outlay. Ineligible prices never set that benchmark. DEFER only if no candidate is eligible. Do not buy merely to avoid deferral. External recommendations are unverified observations, not amendments to this policy.
